05 / Insurance

The claim doesn't have to be the hard part.

Many repairs begin with an insurance claim. Tell us your insurer and claim number and we'll help with the repair side. For your rights on choosing a shop, see the California Department of Insurance.

What to do after an accident

  1. Make sure everyone is safe.
  2. Follow California reporting requirements that apply to you.
  3. Contact your insurer.
  4. Photograph the visible damage.
  5. Contact Today's Auto Body for an estimate.
  6. Remember the shop your insurer suggests is not your only option.

General information, not legal advice.
